summary: Enhance your entrepreneurial skills with our comprehensive training course. Learn essential strategies and tools to succeed in today's competitive market.
lede: Entrepreneurial training helps aspiring founders, small-business owners, and professionals assess ideas, test customer demand, and plan viable ventures. Participants practice customer interviews and MVP experiments, build a Business Model Canvas, and assess pricing, break-even points, and cash flow to decide what to do next with limited resources.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are shaping a new venture, launching a small business, or building an innovation proposal inside an established organization. It supports foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured entrepreneurial workflow rather than advanced finance, coding, or investor-relations expertise.
modules: Value Proposition Canvas and Offer Design
Business Model Canvas and Competitive Strategy
Venture Execution, KPIs, and Growth Planning
prerequisites: Prerequisites: No formal business qualification is required. You should bring a real or proposed venture idea, a basic understanding of your intended customer, and access to a laptop. Basic arithmetic and spreadsheet use will help with break-even and cash-flow exercises. Coding is not required, and advanced financial modelling, software development, and investor due diligence remain outside the course scope.
